annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Plenipotentiary of the Government of the Slovak Republic for Digital Agenda (ODPMII), Government of the Slovak Republic
key_provisions_or_claims: Short-term measures for 2019-2022 implementing the 2030 Digital Transformation Strategy for Slovakia
Four strategic goals: digital education, data and digital economy, innovative public administration, AI development
Review of options and problems for regulating AI and adopt an Act on data
Establish digital innovation hubs and systematic regulatory impact evaluation on innovation
Annual implementation reports to the government, monitored by the ODPMII Directorate General for Digital Agenda
annotation.summary_en: Slovakia's Action Plan for Digital Transformation 2019-2022 implements the 2030 Digital Transformation Strategy. It sets measures on digital education, data economy, smart mobility, FinTech, public administration innovation and AI development, with monitoring by the government's digital agenda office. Hosted on the EU AI Watch portal.
